name: Can I clean up a sewage backup in my commercial building myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I clean up a sewage backup in my commercial building myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cleaning up a sewage backup in a commercial building is not recommended as a DIY project due to significant health risks. Raw sewage contains dangerous pathogens, bacteria, and viruses that can cause serious illness. Professional restoration companies have specialized training, personal protective equipment (PPE), and industrial-grade disinfectants required to safely and effectively handle contaminated materials. They ensure proper containment, disposal, and sanitation, protecting your employees and customers from exposure and ensuring the building is safe for reoccupation.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, cleaning a commercial sewage backup yourself is not recommended due to serious health risks from pathogens. Professionals have the necessary equipment and training.
